article.story: DAYTON, Ohio -- — David Douglas Jr. scored 27 points and Bennett Basich added seven points in the overtime as Northern Illinois knocked off Dayton 81-76 on Saturday. Douglas added six rebounds for the Huskies (1-2). Max Weisbrod scored 19 points and added six rebounds and eight assists. Basich shot 2 for 7 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with nine points. Aiden Derkack finished with 20 points and 10 rebounds for the Flyers (1-1). Dayton also got 19 points and three steals from Landen Joseph. Amael L’Etang finished with 16 points, six rebounds and two steals. Douglas led Northern Illinois with 10 second-half points and Weisbrod hit a 3-pointer with 13 seconds left in regulation that made it 67-all to send the game to overtime. Basich scored their seven the overtime points while finishing 2 of 3 from the floor. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
